messages:
Maria K.: Heads-up: after the sandbox private deploy today, we saw failure decrypting model keys in keystore shim when traffic went through new netpols. Repro steps below.

Ajay P.: ack. Any errors in keystore logs?

Maria K.: Yes — KMS client returns 403-ish. From node agent:
```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z keystore ERROR decrypt failed: access denied (kms:Decrypt) principal=svc-account-prod-keystore
... conntrack: DROP proto=TCP src=10.10.3.5 dst=10.200.0.12 dport=443 reason=NETPOL_REJECT
```

Sam O.: netpol reject line stands out — are we doing egress block to 10.0.0.0/8? Which rule?

Nora L.: We added deny-egress-to-internal in namespace sandbox-keystore last deploy. It matched CIDR used by KMS gateway (10.200.0.0/16).

Ajay P.: That would explain. But why KMS call returns 403 not timeout?

Maria K.: The shim calls an internal proxy that does auth header exchange. Proxy got 200 from KMS but shim sees 403 from KMS because header didn't present due to dropped connect to metadata. Looking at proxy logs:
```
proxy INFO got request from 127.0.0.1 svc=keystore
proxy WARN upstream tls handshake failed: connection reset by peer
proxy INFO upstream response code=403 body="AccessDenied"
```

Sam O.: So netpol killed metadata or egress to auth endpoint intermittently -> auth header missing -> KMS rejects.

Maria K.: Fix plan: 1) revert deny-egress rule in sandbox-keystore, 2) add explicit allow for KMS CIDR and metadata (169.254.169.254/32) in netpol, 3) rotate keystore ephemeral keys if any scope changed, 4) add audit log filter to capture metadata failures. Also canary fallback to hosted keystore for affected namespaces.

Ajay P.: +1. Add a rule example pls.

Maria K.: Here's suggested patch:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-keystore-egress-kms
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.200.0.0/16 # KMS gateway
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 169.254.169.254/32 # metadata
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

Nora L.: Can we also add a conntrack tuning note? During bench we saw conntrack exhaustion when agent retries spiked.

Sam O.: Good call. Add conntrack sysctl doc link and increase hashsize for onprem nodes. And add a small readiness check in keystore to fail-open to hosted if local KMS auth fails >3 attempts.

Maria K.: I'll open an incident runbook update + a short postmortem. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-decrypt-fallback

sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-4517 by Maria K. Priority: P2. Playbook assigned to Ajay P.

Ajay P.: I'll push the netpol patch to canary now, will monitor audit logs. Ping me if you see more 403s.

Nora L.: Thx. Adding chase item to weekly hardening checklist: when tightening egress ensure allow list includes service endpoints used by control plane and creds exchange.

Maria K.: closing loop: reverted rule w/patch r1234, observed decrypts recovered within 45s. Postmortem draft incoming.
